overview: The Medford City Council met for its first regular meeting of 2023 to elect council leadership, adopt operating rules, and address local resolutions. The council elected Nicole Morell as President and Zac Bears as Vice President, and received a presentation on a proposed $2.6 million redesign of the McGlynn Playground.

items.title: Election of Council President
items.summary: Nicole Morell was elected Council President for calendar year 2023.

items.title: Election of Council Vice President
items.summary: Zac Bears was elected Council Vice President for calendar year 2023.

items.title: Adoption of Standing Rules
items.summary: The Council adopted its standing committee rules for calendar year 2023.

items.title: Transfer of Pending Papers
items.summary: The Council approved transferring all pending committee papers from 2022 to the 2023 Council.

items.title: Commendation for Arts Collaborative Medford
items.summary: The Council passed a resolution congratulating Arts Collaborative Medford on the planned opening of its new Community Arts Center on Mystic Avenue.

items.title: Approval of Meeting Records
items.summary: The Council approved the meeting records from December 20, 2022.

items.title: Open Session Report on Fuel Storage Tanks Litigation
items.summary: The Council approved an open session report regarding fuel storage tanks litigation ahead of an upcoming remanded hearing.

items.title: Resolution on Street Sweeping and Snow Emergency Communications
items.summary: The Council passed an amended resolution requesting that the administration and Traffic Commission explore options and report back on communications and signage for street sweeping and snow emergencies.

items.title: Discussion on Freedom Way Paving
items.summary: The Council passed an amended resolution requesting a cost breakdown from the city engineer regarding temporary paving work on Freedom Way.

items.title: FAA Airplane Noise Review Update
items.summary: The Council passed a resolution requesting an update from the federal delegation on the FAA review of flight path dispersion recommendations affecting Medford.

items.title: Request for Joint Meeting on School Safety and Budget
items.summary: The Council approved an amended resolution requesting a joint meeting with the School Committee to discuss school safety measures and funding for the fiscal year 2024 budget.

items.title: Condolence Resolution for Gerald Bradnese
items.summary: The Council passed a condolence resolution honoring former firefighter and veteran Gerald Bradnese.

items.title: Recognition of Student Athletes
items.summary: The Council approved a motion to invite the 2022 Girls Varsity Soccer GBL champions and cross country champion Anna Casey to be recognized at a future meeting.

items.title: Presentation on McGlynn Playground Redesign
items.summary: The Council received a presentation on a proposed $2.6 million universally accessible redesign of the McGlynn Playground, which includes $750,000 in requested ARPA funds, and placed the paper on file.
